# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 12 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f6f8fb);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #0e1424);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f6f8fb;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f6f8fb | #0e1424 | Fondo de página. Reemplaza el blanco plano de la referencia por un gris azulado muy suave que separa las tarjetas. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #161e33 | Tarjetas de producto, header en scroll, modales, buscador. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #eef2f8 | #0a0f1c | Fondo de la foto de producto, inputs, zonas de carrusel. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #0f1b3d);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #eef2fa);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0f1b3d;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #0f1b3d | #eef2fa | Texto principal y precios sobre surface, surface-raised y surface-sunken. |
| `--ink-muted` | #56637f | #a3aec7 | Texto secundario: presentación del producto, precio tachado, textos legales de banners. Legible sobre surface y surface-raised en ambos temas. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */

```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |

| `--on-brand` | #ffffff | #0e1424 | Texto e íconos sobre fondo brand. |
| `--on-brand-deep` | #ffffff | #eef2fa | Texto sobre brand-deep (header, footer). |
| `--on-care` | #ffffff | #0e1424 | Texto sobre care. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #dce3ee);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #2a3452);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #dce3ee;
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #dce3ee | #2a3452 | Bordes de tarjetas, divisores del footer, borde de inputs en reposo. |
| `--brand` | #2347b8 | #7c9bff | Azul de marca (evolución del #344F9C de la referencia, más vivo). Botón Agregar, links 'Ver más', íconos activos, foco. |
| `--brand-deep` | #13265f | #1b2a55 | Header principal y footer (en la referencia ambos eran #344F9C plano). Texto encima: on-brand-deep. |
| `--brand-soft` | #e7edff | #1d2a52 | Chips de categoría, hover de tarjetas, fondo de íconos de categoría. Texto encima: brand. |
| `--care` | #0b7a5e | #4fd1a8 | Verde salud (nuevo). Disponibilidad, 'Envío gratis', atención farmacéutica, mensajes de éxito. Texto sobre care: on-care. |
| `--care-soft` | #e2f6ef | #12352c | Fondo de badges de stock y del bloque de beneficios. Texto encima: care. |
| `--promo` | #d6283a | #ff6b78 | Rojo de oferta (heredado del #D7121D de la referencia). SOLO descuentos (-30%), precio oferta y contador de carrito. Nunca decorativo. |
| `--promo-soft` | #fde8ea | #3a1820 | Fondo de la barra de campaña y badges de oferta suaves. Texto encima: promo. |
| `--highlight` | #f5b82e | #f5b82e | Amarillo de campaña (BotiDays-style). Etiquetas 'Nuevo', '3x2', puntos activos del hero. Texto encima siempre ink claro (#0F1B3D). |
| `--whatsapp` | #1da851 | #25d366 | Solo el botón flotante de WhatsApp. |
| `--focus` | #2347b8 | #9db4ff | Anillo de foco de teclado, 2px con 2px de separación. |
| `--overlay` | rgba(15, 27, 61, 0.55) | rgba(5, 8, 16, 0.65) | Velo sobre fotos lifestyle para poner texto blanco encima (bloques de campaña). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 800 44px/48px "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Poppins", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 44px / 48px | 800 | `sans` | Texto grande de bloques de campaña ('Lo esencial para estar preparado'). |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 32px / 40px | 800 | `sans` | Títulos de página (categoría, búsqueda). |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 26px / 34px | 700 | `sans` | Título de sección de la home ('Cuidado para tu piel'). En la referencia: 28px/600 centrado. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 18px / 26px | 700 | `sans` | Títulos de columnas del footer, subtítulos. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Texto general. |
| `product-name` | `.product-name`, `--text-product-name` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Nombre de producto, máximo 2 líneas con elipsis. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Links del footer, utility bar, ayudas. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Textos legales bajo banners, presentación (Frasco 50 ml). |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 700 | `sans` | Badges (-30%, 3x2, Nuevo). Mayúsculas con 0.02em de tracking. |
| `price` | `.price`, `--text-price` | 22px / 28px | 800 | `sans` | Precio actual en tarjeta (S/ 83.90). Tabular numbers. |
| `price-old` | `.price-old`, `--text-price-old` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Precio regular tachado en ink-muted. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Plus Jakarta Sans", "Poppins", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Separación icono-texto. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap de chips, padding de badges. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap entre tarjetas en móvil, padding interno de tarjeta. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Padding de tarjeta, gap entre tarjetas en desktop. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gutter del contenedor, separación título-contenido. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Separación entre banners y carruseles. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Separación entre secciones de la home. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Padding vertical del footer. |

| --- | --- | --- |

